schema.name: queue_items
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE queue_items (
  room_id  TEXT    NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  id       TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  embed    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (room_id, id)
) STRICT

schema.name: reports
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE reports (
  id         TEXT    NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 22),
  room_id    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  reason     TEXT    NOT NULL,
  note       TEXT,
  room_title TEXT,
  embed_url  TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open', 'dismissed', 'actioned'))
) STRICT

schema.name: reports_room_state
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX reports_room_state ON reports (room_id, state)

schema.name: rooms
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE rooms (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
  title       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  layout      TEXT NOT NULL,
  embed       TEXT
, visibility     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public' CHECK (visibility IN ('public', 'private')), pinned         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (pinned IN (0, 1)), owner_hash     BLOB    CHECK (owner_hash IS NULL OR length(owner_hash) = 32), invite_hash    BLOB    CHECK (invite_hash IS NULL OR length(invite_hash) = 32), last_active_at INTEGER, control_policy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'everyone' CHECK (control_policy IN ('everyone', 'owner')), item_id TEXT) STRICT

schema.name: seat_holds
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE seat_holds (
  room_id    TEXT    NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name_hash  BLOB    NOT NULL CHECK (length(name_hash) = 32),
  seat       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seat >= 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (room_id, name_hash)
) STRICT

schema.name: takedowns
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE takedowns (
  room_id TEXT    NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  at      INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
